text:
After completing my compression homework, the next in line for me (and to complete the approach section in Marketpedia) is the 3Drive. I found this example on the Dollar Index Weekly Chart. 3Drives into supply. Notes are on the chart...

If we take a look at the PA on the daily chart for the 3Drive from the weekly chart above, it is possible to see more examples of potential 3Drives...

I wish I had the data to take this example down to lower time frames, as it looks like there is a lot of interesting PA in here!

perhaps, 3Drives within a 3Drive, within a 3Drive... like, 3Drive inception?

author: moogroo
text: Homework Continues...looking at AUDUSD again starting with a drive up to supply the monthly chart that caught my eye, so naturally I wanted to dive in and investigate!

author: moogroo
text:
Next one! I spotted an approach to a weekly supply area, again on AUDUSD

Zooming into the daily chart, we see that the approach was a 3Drive. Where price reacted to through, was not all that clear, with how compressed price looked in the supply area.

But going into the 1H chart to have a look showed the fresh decision point, where fresh orders clearly existed.

Back to the 3Drive in question, this is the 4H chart...This reveals another 3 drive through the FL..

And even in the approach to the RBD of peak [1] and [3] from the daily chart, shows 3Drives on approach in the 1H chart for each of these,

I enjoyed studying and marking this one up today... I think my eyes are becoming more attuned to them and I hope I'm on the right track with these!
